title: University of Minnesota Taiwanese Student Association
content_html:
The University of Minnesota Taiwanese Student Association (UMNTSA), also referred to as the Taiwan Student Association UMN (明尼蘇達 台灣同學會), appears in two separate legacy Google Sites and a Facebook group, suggesting it may have operated in parallel with or separately from the Taiwanese Student Society (TSS). According to its own website, the organization’s primary goal was to serve and help Taiwanese students at the University of Minnesota and in the broader Twin Cities area, including hosting summer information sessions for incoming students, arranging airport pickups on request, and organizing social activities throughout the school year. The organization also welcomed students from other ethnic backgrounds to participate and learn about Taiwanese culture.

No current GopherLink registration for UMNTSA or a standalone ‘Taiwan Student Association’ at UMN has been confirmed through available sources. The organization’s Google Sites pages show no recent activity, and the @umn_tsa Instagram account exists but does not display publicly accessible content. The TSS WordPress events page lists ‘明大台灣同學會 UMN Taiwan Student Association’ as a distinct linked organization, indicating it was recognized as a separate group, but its current registration status is unclear.
